apariciones.subtitulo: An opinion framed by its own confidence

mision.consigna: Give your view on whether travel changes anyone in a way that lasts.
requisitos: acknowledge the difficulty before answering
signal exactly how firmly you hold the view
one *I could be persuaded otherwise by…* with a specific condition
use *a rite of passage*, *to find your feet* and *to go off the beaten track*

microtareas.texto: Write your view in one line. Above it, why the question is hard.
Write what evidence would move you.
Record 2 minutes on *hospitality* abroad and *losing your bearings*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Hedging a complaint about a backlog

mision.consigna: Write to an authority about a case that has been stuck for months, hedged exactly as far as your evidence goes.
requisitos: no more than two hedges in the whole text
one claim stated flat, and a line saying why
one *As far as I can tell*
use *a backlog*, *to chase something up* and *to lodge an appeal*

microtareas.texto: Write three claims about the delay. Hedge each only as far as you can support it.
Remove one hedge that makes you sound weaker than your evidence.
Record 2 minutes on being *passed from pillar to post*. Careful, not evasive.

apariciones.subtitulo: A story that withholds, then resolves

mision.consigna: Tell the story of an environmental measure you supported or opposed, controlling what the listener knows at each point.
requisitos: one deliberate false lead the listener believes
a reveal placed for maximum effect
one *At the time, I assumed… It wasn't.*
use *stewardship*, *to offset emissions* and *to be a drop in the ocean*

microtareas.texto: Write what the listener should believe halfway through.
Write the single line that overturns it.
Record 2 minutes on *carrying capacity*. Control what they know when.

apariciones.subtitulo: A prediction as a scenario tree

mision.consigna: Forecast how care for long-term conditions will change over the next decade.
requisitos: the most probable path and one credible alternative
the specific signal that would tell you which is happening
one *That said, a lot could change*
use *a clinical picture*, *to be in remission* and *to advocate for yourself*

microtareas.texto: Name the signal you'd watch to know which path it's on.
Write the alternative scenario in three sentences.
Record 2 minutes on how *a flare-up* *takes its toll* over years.

apariciones.subtitulo: Understatement about a job that outgrew you

mision.consigna: Describe a role that quietly became unmanageable — wry throughout, with one moment of plain sincerity.
requisitos: understatement for most of the text
one clear, marked switch to directness
the reason for the switch evident to the reader
use *to be spread thin*, *to tread water* and *institutional knowledge*

microtareas.texto: Write three understated lines about the workload.
Write the one sentence where irony would be wrong.
Record 2 minutes on *delegating* and having *an exit strategy*.

apariciones.subtitulo: The same summary for two audiences

mision.consigna: Summarise the state of an ageing system twice: for the engineers who maintain it and for the manager who funds it.
requisitos: shared background compressed aggressively for the experts
the genuinely new part expanded for each audience
one *I'll assume you know…, so let's focus on…*
use *technical debt*, *a single point of failure* and *to future-proof*

microtareas.texto: List what the engineers already know about *a legacy system*. Cut it.
Write what the manager needs that the engineers don't.
Record 2 minutes on *interoperability* for someone new to it.

mision.consigna: Give feedback to a cook or a host on a meal that didn't land the way they hoped.
requisitos: observation and interpretation explicitly separated
the interpretation offered as something they can correct
one question that genuinely hands them the floor
use *mouthfeel*, *to let something rest* and *to be an acquired taste*

microtareas.texto: Write three observations about the dish — no interpretation at all.
Add your interpretation as a hypothesis: *My guess is…, but tell me if that's off.*
Record 2 minutes on *seasonality* as feedback, not as a verdict.

apariciones.subtitulo: Alternating emphasis in a consumer column

mision.consigna: Write an argumentative column on why things are built to be replaced.
requisitos: inversion, cleft and fronting, alternating — no device twice in a row
one *Nowhere is this clearer than in…*
one sentence deliberately without emphasis
use *planned obsolescence*, *a price point* and *to curb your spending*

microtareas.texto: Draft the argument plain. Mark the three sentences that deserve weight.
Assign a different device to each.
Record 2 minutes on *aspirational marketing*. One inversion, one cleft.

apariciones.subtitulo: Register on six axes in a newsroom

mision.consigna: Write about the same editorial decision three ways: a note to a colleague, a message to the editor, and a public statement.
requisitos: register controlled on at least four axes
one deliberate mismatch on a single axis for effect — and say which
the same facts in all three
use *editorial independence*, *to be on the record* and *to bury the lede*

microtareas.texto: Take one sentence about *a news cycle* and shift it along one axis at a time.
Find a register leak in something you wrote this week and name the axis.
Record 2 minutes as an editor explaining why a piece was *fact-checked* again.

apariciones.subtitulo: Running the conversation, not just your turns

mision.consigna: Describe how you'd steer a club discussion where one member dominates and a newcomer says nothing.
requisitos: drawing in a silent participant without spotlighting them
one redirection that is never announced as such
one repair of a misunderstanding between two others
use *a pastime*, *to be in your element* and *to plateau*

microtareas.texto: Write three ways to bring someone in without *You haven't said anything*.
Write a redirect that sounds like a continuation, not a correction.
Record 2 minutes on *a lifelong pursuit*. Invite the listener in twice.

apariciones.subtitulo: Naming their interest before they do

mision.consigna: Negotiate a way back into a friendship that cooled after an unspoken slight.
requisitos: name the other person's real interest before they state it
one *Is that a fair read of where you're coming from?*
one concession given freely, not traded
use *an unspoken rule*, *to hold a grudge* and *to mend fences*

microtareas.texto: Write the three interests they might have that they won't say aloud.
Write your opening line naming one of them.
Record 2 minutes on *emotional labour* and being *at cross purposes*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Disagreeing at the right level about money

mision.consigna: Respond to the claim that anyone who owns property has nothing to worry about.
requisitos: name which part you contest: premise, logic or conclusion
one part you explicitly grant
one *That's a separate question from…*
use *to be asset-rich but cash-poor*, *liquidity* and *to weather a downturn*

microtareas.texto: Break the claim into premise, logic and conclusion in three lines.
Write one sentence attacking each — then pick the strongest.
Record 2 minutes on *a sunk cost* and *overextending yourself*.
